base_member_text: [L6-L9] (MED/communicator-mismatch) Invalid root handling aborts MPI_COMM_WORLD rather than the supplied comm communicator, which can terminate unrelated ranks when comm is a subcommunicator.
audit_member_text: [L6-L9] (LOW/overbroad abort scope) A bad root for the supplied communicator aborts `MPI_COMM_WORLD` rather than `comm`, unexpectedly terminating ranks outside a subcommunicator that invoked this routine.

base_member_text: [L2-L3,L44-L46,L59-L61,L65-L66,L70,L73] (MED/unchecked-mpi-status) MPI return codes are repeatedly overwritten and never tested, allowing communicator, datatype, collective, or cleanup failures to remain undetected.
audit_member_text: [L2-L3,L44-L46,L59-L66,L69-L73] (MED/unchecked MPI failures) All MPI error codes are overwritten without inspection, so communicator, datatype-construction, commit, collective, or free failures can cascade into use or freeing of invalid datatype handles.

base_member_text: [L41-L45,L55-L61] (MED/unchecked-subarray-bounds) Partition sizes and starts are passed to MPI_Type_create_subarray without checking that they are positive and lie within shape(a) or shape(b).
audit_member_text: [L41-L45,L55-L60] (MED/unchecked subarray bounds) The generated MPI subarray types assume every `lm`/`ln` is positive and fits the corresponding `a` or `b` extent and every `is`/`js` start is in range, with no validation before `MPI_Type_create_subarray`.

base_member_text: [L12-L17,L68-L75] (MED/allocation-lifetime) The template allocates six work arrays but never deallocates them after the collective and datatype cleanup.
[L7] (LOW/misleading-diagnostic) The diagnostic hard-codes matrix_distr_real8 although the generic template itself does not constrain the generated routine to that name or type.
